summary: 15,752 pages sit on 44 locale sites (251–556 pages each); 24,780 more are generated /flights/ route pages in 55 language/market variants.
The English–Thailand site (551 pages) has 80 sections and 278 sub-sections; the hierarchy goes at most about two levels below a section.
53 sections appear on at least 42 of the 44 locale sites. German, French and Italian translate their section URLs (local-only sections: de-de 24, fr-fr 28, it-it 27).
Flight pages fall into 7 URL types: from-X-to-Y 17,442, to-X 4,837, from-X 900, business-class 760, campaign/deal 455, link-listing 331, hubs 55.
observations: 97% of locale pages sit under a /content/ container folder that carries no meaning; section names start one level below it.
The /flights/ pages look programmatically generated from route data (17,442 from-X-to-Y pages alone), so they are likely a handful of templates fed by data, not hand-authored pages.

Only 15 distinct campaign/deal pages exist: 11 English campaigns repeated on 41 English country sites, plus locale-only ones. 3 of them are utility pages (bootstrap-enabled, destination-information, privacy-policy).
3,737 flight URLs use non-Latin characters (Thai, Japanese, Chinese, Korean) in the address.
Housekeeping candidates in the inventory: 608 dated/historical privacy-policy versions, 484 /content/redirect/ stubs, 45 technical pages (healthcheck, under-maintenance).
Sitemap data quality: 32 entries have a doubled slash after the domain (/en-tw/sitemap.xml, /es-es/sitemap.xml, /tr-tr/sitemap.xml, /vi-vn/sitemap.xml).
recommendations: Model the /flights/ pages as data-driven templates (one per URL type) fed by route data, rather than migrating ~25k pages one by one.
Treat the 44 locale sites as regional/translated variants of one content tree: migrate one reference tree (en-th) and localise, with a URL map for the translated section slugs in de/fr/it.
Decide the URL strategy for non-Latin slugs (keep, transliterate or redirect) before building the flights templates.
Exclude or redirect rather than migrate: /content/redirect/ stubs, healthcheck/under-maintenance pages and flights utility pages; archive the dated privacy-policy versions.
Fix the doubled-slash sitemap entries at source.
methodology: Structure scan one level below each section, and classification of flight URLs into 7 types using localised "from/to" wording (en, th, de, fr, it, no, sv, tr, ko, zh, ja).
appendix: Discovery: 100 sitemaps (44 locale sitemaps plus the flights index and its 55 children), all fetched successfully; 0 listed URLs fell under robots Disallow rules.
A test render of 24 pages was blocked by Cloudflare after 3 pages and stopped immediately. Allowlisting was requested and declined; no further page requests were made.
